title: Woven Garage Stutter
description: A pitched dirt sample is striated into interleaved grains that stutter and weave across the stereo field on a perlin/saw pan drift, while stepped speed shifts its register and a slow filter+crush morph opens and closes the timbre. Mid-low, rhythmic and glitchy — a garage edit layer that resolves into a dry room tail.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
stack(
  s("east*2")
    .striate("<8 8 16 8 12 16 8 24>/2")
    .speed("<0.5 0.75 0.5 1 0.5 0.75 0.5 0.66>")
    .ply("<1 2 1 1 2 1 4 1>/2")
    .sometimesBy(0.22, x => x.speed(-1))
    .pan(perlin.range(0.08, 0.92).fast(2))
    .jux(x => x.pan(saw.range(0.9, 0.1).slow(7)))
    .lpf(sine.slow(23).range(420, 2600))
    .resonance(saw.slow(13).range(6, 14))
    .crush("<16 16 8 16 6 16 16 4>/2")
    .shape(perlin.range(0.1, 0.42).slow(11))
    .room(saw.slow(29).range(0.08, 0.24))
    .roomsize(2)
    .gain(0.92)
)
